w_definition_lock.specimen_family: straight rectangular equal-layer vacuum-jammed cantilever, material root s=0 and free material end s=L, planar quasi-static bending
w_definition_lock.physical_definition: w(P;p,n)=e_y dot [rbar_tip(P,p,n)-rbar_tip(0,p,n)] on first monotonic loading branch; rbar_tip is thickness-weighted mean of initial free-end material-section layer-centerline points
w_definition_lock.observation_point: initial free-end material section, not shifted current geometric cross-section
w_definition_lock.direction: fixed laboratory external load axis e_y; positive along applied transverse force
w_definition_lock.baseline: equilibrated pressure-only state at same p,n
w_definition_lock.external_load: measured global transverse force resultant P in N
w_definition_lock.branch: first monotonic loading after declared pressure dwell/preconditioning
w_definition_lock.interpolation: linear between adjacent converged first-branch states in P; no extrapolation; jumps bracketed rather than smoothed
w_definition_lock.M_extraction: material centerline tip displacement minus pressure-only baseline
w_definition_lock.R_extraction: thickness-weighted mean displacement of same initial layer-end material points minus baseline
w_definition_lock.future_E_extraction: direct visible free-end layer fiducials or validated optical centroid; remove fixture motion and baseline; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE
w_definition_lock.optional_normalization: divide by positive predeclared engineering W_use when supplied; no division by w_R near zero
w_definition_lock.near_zero_rule: use absolute error in m without switching denominator

K_definition_lock.selected_rule: service-window chord at common independently specified P_service_low and P_service_high on first loading branch, with same pressure state

candidate_rule_audit.A_fixed_absolute: comparable but must connect to service load and may cross different slip regimes
candidate_rule_audit.B_service_fraction: engineering relevant if independent, but arbitrary fractions unjustified; selected instead actual service window endpoints
candidate_rule_audit.C_onset_fraction: rejected as primary due circularity and non-equivalent onset
candidate_rule_audit.D_pre_slip: secondary diagnostic only until independent onset proof
candidate_rule_audit.E_pre_post: future separate metrics requiring two independent interval locks

K_definition_lock.branch_and_regime: first monotonic branch; a service interval that crosses slip remains mixed-regime and is reported as such, not moved post hoc
K_definition_lock.interpolation: use locked w interpolation; endpoint jump implies interval-censored or undefined chord
K_definition_lock.near_zero_rule: if endpoint delta_w is unresolved relative to propagated uncertainty, K is NOT_ESTIMABLE

Q_slip_correspondence.primary_carrier: external applied force at onset P_onset in N, tagged by evidence level; not a claim that all levels are identical

levels.L1_M: analytical first eligible section yield at abs(Q(s))=(2/3)*mu*p*b*h; record s_M, internal Q and external P_M
levels.L2_R: first persistent spatially resolved local interface motion/contact transition, external load bracket [P_R_minus,P_R_plus]
levels.L3_E: first directly observed physical relative-layer motion in registered patch, external load bracket [P_E_minus,P_E_plus]

Q_slip_correspondence.observation_domain: interior initial material span [s_a,s_b], excluding clamp footprint, free-end load footprint and pilot-mapped fixture-pressure boundary zones; stations pending pilot freeze
Q_slip_correspondence.boundary_exclusion: excluded-region events reported separately as boundary onset, never counted as interior first slip
Q_slip_correspondence.spatial_persistence: connected same-interface patch of common physical length at least ell_g with coherent signed relative motion, above shared mesh/camera spatial resolution; ell_g pending pilot
Q_slip_correspondence.temporal_persistence: cumulative same-direction motion above d_g over resolved next load increment; otherwise unresolved bracket; d_g and sampling pending no-slip noise pilot
Q_slip_correspondence.numerical_threshold: derived from converged contact regularization and no-slip chatter floor, not a chosen percentage or fitted M-R agreement
Q_slip_correspondence.experimental_threshold: derived from calibrated direct-marker/DIC no-slip noise and false-event rate with synchronized force/pressure; no number yet
Q_slip_correspondence.censoring: last resolved no-event to first resolved event interval; left censor if earlier than detection, right censor if absent by load maximum; do not silently use midpoint
Q_slip_correspondence.interval_distance: d(P_M,[P_minus,P_plus])=max(P_minus-P_M,0,P_M-P_plus), reported with full bracket; zero means interval compatibility only
Q_slip_correspondence.contact_chatter: reject isolated node or step toggles; require patch, persistence and mesh/contact/increment convergence
Q_slip_correspondence.P_to_Q_mapping: use M internal Q at recorded event material station and external P; for R secondary Q integrate section resultant at same initial material station/P; never assume Q=P in curved/end-loaded case
